summary: Consoles without zone-based firewall sync with a warning, and rule-predict names the cause.
reason: The Network API answers firewall zones and policies with HTTP 400 api.firewall.zone-based-firewall-not-configured on consoles using legacy rules. That counted as a sync error, and rule-predict told the user to run sync, which can never help.
validated_outcome: Live sync on a legacy-firewall console reports 0 errors; rule-predict states the legacy firewall reason after a sync.
